articles.summary:
Gibney, 78, has faced justice for abusing athletes in the 1970s and 80s after decades of effort to track and extradite him

More than half a century after he started sexually abusing children, and enjoyed prestige as Ireland’s Olympic swimming coach before fleeing to the United States, George Gibney has faced justice.

The 78-year-old was sentenced to 15 and a half years in prison at the central criminal court in Dublin on Monday for abusing four young female athletes in the 1970s and 1980s.

articles.title: Burnham accepts Brexit result ‘legitimate’ despite Russian interference, says No 10 – UK politics live
articles.summary:
PM ‘absolutely accepts referendum result’, says spokesperson

  • Burnham to urge MPs to embrace closer ties with EU

Zia Yusuf, Reform UK’s home affairs spokesperson, is speaking now. He started his speech with an account of a 73-year-old woman dying in North Wales after having to wait 23 hours for an ambulance, and he sought to link this to immigration.

He said:

The Royal College of Emergency Medicine estimates that 15,000 people across Britain died last year due to excess wait times for emergency treatment. That’s 300 people a week, 300 lives destroyed, 300 families devastated.

And that number has increased tenfold over the last decade. This is a moral outrage, and it is a direct result of decisions made by Tory and Labour governments.

I don’t think that’s because he wants to have a fight over the European Union. I think that’s because he knows what we’re talking about today impacts hard in what is known as the red wall.

Fragile coalition suffers another blow as labour minister and co-leader of SPD Bärbel Bas leaves both posts

Germany’s labour minister and co-leader of the centre-left ⁠Social Democrats (SPD), Bärbel Bas, has quit both posts, citing the death of her stepdaughter and subsequent political attacks against her, in a stinging blow to the fragile coalition government.

“After my stepdaughter’s death, I realised that I need time to come to terms with my grief,” Bas said in a statement posted on Facebook, without giving further ⁠details.

Makroekonomické prostředí zatěžují rostoucí výnosy dluhopisů, přísnější sankce vůči Rusku a přetrvávající nejistota kolem energetické politiky.
archive.security_status_en: Europe is facing escalating security tensions as the Kremlin rejects a truce in Ukraine, while internal stability in countries like Germany and France is shaken by government crises, political attacks, and social unrest. The macroeconomic environment is burdened by rising bond yields, stricter sanctions on Russia, and persistent uncertainty surrounding energy policy.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat pokračující volatilitu na trzích, poháněnou výsledkovou sezónou bank a reakcemi na diplomatické manévry ohledně konfliktu na Ukrajině.
archive.forecast_en: Continued market volatility is expected over the coming days, driven by the bank earnings season and reactions to diplomatic maneuvers regarding the conflict in Ukraine.

archive.security_status_cs: Evropa čelí stupňujícímu se napětí v důsledku hybridních hrozeb, kolapsu německé vládní koalice po rezignaci ministra práce a rostoucích bezpečnostních incidentů včetně útoků na infrastrukturu. Mezitím EU schválila největší balíček protiruských sankcí a potýká se s diplomatickým zmatkem ohledně amerických návrhů na příměří na Ukrajině.
archive.security_status_en: Europe is facing escalating tensions driven by hybrid threats, the collapse of Germany's ruling coalition following the labor minister's resignation, and rising security incidents including infrastructure attacks. Meanwhile, the EU has approved its largest package of anti-Russia sanctions and is grappling with diplomatic confusion surrounding US proposals for a Ukraine ceasefire.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat zvýšenou volatilitu trhů pod vlivem výsledkové sezóny, vyjednávání o příměří na Ukrajině a politických dopadů německé vládní krize.
archive.forecast_en: Increased market volatility is expected over the coming days, driven by earnings season, ceasefire negotiations on Ukraine, and the political fallout of the German government crisis.
